name: testnet-faucet
description: Self-hosted Node service that drips 0.1% of its current reserves of testnet WART to requesting addresses. Talks to a public defi testnet node. Used by the website's /testnet page.

scripts.dev: bash -c 'KEY=$(node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/dev-privkey.cjs); if [ -n "$KEY" ]; then export FAUCET_HEX_PRIVKEY="$KEY"; fi; ENV_FLAG=""; [ -f .env ] && ENV_FLAG="--env-file-if-exists=.env"; NODE_ENV=development PORT=$(node scripts/find-free-port.cjs) node $ENV_FLAG --watch src/server.js'
